joinNotice.title: You've been added to {{org}}
joinNotice.auto_join: Your email address matches this organization's sign-in rule, so you were added to {{org}} automatically when you signed in.
joinNotice.invite: You accepted an invitation to {{org}}, so you are now a member.
joinNotice.sandboxIntro: You are on our shared starter instance, in an isolated environment of your own. The sample data is a private copy — nothing you do here is visible to another visitor, and nothing here touches anyone else's data.
joinNotice.sandboxOpen: Almost every operation is open to you: register your own sources, model them, write policies and masking rules, and query the result in SQL, GraphQL, or Cypher.
joinNotice.sandboxHeldBack: Held back are the org-wide controls — switching or managing environments, inviting people and conferring roles, org settings, and org-wide observability. Those pages stay visible, marked as part of the production system.
joinNotice.sandboxTemporary: Your environment is temporary. Signing out wipes it, and it is also reclaimed after a day of inactivity. Nothing you build here is meant to be kept.
joinNotice.sandboxUpgrade: When you are ready for an organization that persists, upgrade to a Starter plan.
